title: Ericsson Cellular Networking Sales Certification
summary: I designed and developed cellular networking sales certification for Ericsson sellers and channel partners, translating technical and product source material into seller-focused discovery, solution-fit, scenario-practice, assessment, LMS, and maintenance workflows.

content.business_need: Create a maintainable Ericsson sales-learning pathway that gave internal sellers and channel partners enough cellular-networking fluency to recognize customer needs, ask useful discovery questions, distinguish solution approaches, explain value, and choose an appropriate next sales step without turning the certification into engineering training.
content.audience: Ericsson internal sellers and channel partners with mixed levels of cellular-networking experience.
learning_objectives: Recognize customer situations where enterprise cellular connectivity may be relevant.
Distinguish solution approaches using customer workflows, users, constraints, and desired outcomes.
Ask discovery questions that connect connectivity symptoms to business impact.
Choose an appropriate next sales step and know when technical specialist support is needed.
content.role: Lead instructional designer and LMS administrator responsible for curriculum architecture, learning development, assessment design, review coordination, learner-path testing, reporting support, and ongoing content maintenance.
content.design_approach: Used backward design around seller decisions rather than product recall. I separated the broadly required path, market-specific extensions, and optional technical foundations so sellers received the depth relevant to their role and route.
content.development_process: Translated approved technical, product, and sales inputs into Rise and Storyline learning; built diagrams, comparisons, scenarios, knowledge checks, and certification assessment; coordinated staged QA and SME review; validated learner routes and renewal behavior in the LMS; and maintained the certification as approved source information changed.
outcomes: Released a multi-course cellular networking sales certification with scenario practice, assessment, and LMS implementation support.
Separated broadly relevant and market-specific requirements into clearer learner routes.
Supported supplemental assessment and reporting logic when platform completion states did not fully match the certification design.
